author: Sega Jenesis
title: Hiring digital artists for custom Pokemon binder scenes
content:
🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀

I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them!

I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters.

Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway!

Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚

If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰

author: Romance Fiction Club
title: Hiring character artist for large project
content:
We’re looking to hire a character artist who can take on a large project. Any authors have reccomendations? Human made artwork only please.

Contact via replies with recommendations or portfolios in the thread.

author: Meg Humble
title: Looking for character artists for 2 full body characters
content:
I know imma regret this, but I’m looking for character artists who have space in November for 2 full body characters (no background needed) ideally for less than £300 
🚫 AI
🚫 DMs

Authors please also rec people you have used! 🥰

Contact via public comments/recommendations only (no DMs).

author: Aurora Crate Book Box
title: Seeking artists with availability through end of 2026
content:
We’re looking for some artists with availability between now and the end of 2026. Self recs welcome, please include price list + some examples. No dms please.

Also to clarify, NO AI - human artists only please.

Contact via public replies with price lists and examples (no DMs).

author: Squirrel
title: Looking for artist for novel character art
content:
🎨 Calling all artists! I’m planning to self-publish my novel within the next year and I’m looking for an artist to create character art for my two main characters. ✨ One important requirement: NO AI art or AI tools used at any stage of the process. I had a bad experience earlier this year with someone who claimed their work was fully human-made, only to discover otherwise after paying. I want to work with a real artist and support genuine creativity, and I’m happy to pay fairly for your work!

Contact via replies in the thread with portfolios.

author: Or Cole
title: Seeking character artist for upcoming book with flexible payment
content:
I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please!

I am a romance author... Contact via replies or DMs with portfolios and willingness for payment plans.
